changes: Three ordered activities: preparation, optional stories/advice, one session from the exact prepared package.
Story topic/context selection; original-vs-story comparison; partial apply/cancel; chosen stories persist in independent tasks and PDF. Math answers and parameters retained.
Actual session context enables the visible Minta saran AI action; static teaching cards remain usable without AI.
Discussion opening explains its ungraded purpose; topic selector chooses an existing context without changing assessment/tasks.
The preserved 32-response example is on /guru/simulasi; no duplicate session or pairing form in practice.
Sample lease renews every 30s/focus/online and expired own lease can be renewed once before a pairing retry. Different active controller requires explicit takeover.
Preparation action stays 48px high at desktop and mobile; technical/draft details are disclosed when requested.

Moving between journey steps closes the previous step without unmounting cached drafts or the ongoing session. Arrival collapses old three-open preferences; deliberate manual disclosure choices remain possible.
The printable independent-task review footer uses the same plain language as the UI.
